question: What is the maximum normal working week, and does it differ for employees under 18?
answer: The normal working time for an employee may not exceed forty hours per week, whether under a five-day or six-day working week [Art. 182]. Yes, it differs for employees under 18: working time is set at no more than thirty-six hours per week for employees aged sixteen to eighteen, and no more than twenty-four hours per week for persons aged fifteen to sixteen [Art. 415]. In addition, during the academic year, students working in their free time from studies may not work more than half of the maximum working time provided in part one of that article for persons of the corresponding age [Art. 415].
